v7UiRefinement.verifiedOnIntegration: SHA-256, byte count, dimension va pixel mode cua ca 10 file da doi chieu voi asset board truoc khi dang ky. 10/10 khop.
v7UiRefinement.rule: Moi ID dung dung mot vi tri; khong dung cheo giua cac slug. Render toi da 560px CSS, object-contain, alt="" + aria-hidden.
v7UiRefinement.exception: v7-page-about-values la RGB nen den (khong phai RGBA) — chi dung tren nen den kem mix-blend-lighten.

v8ServiceDepth.verifiedOnIntegration: SHA-256, byte count, dimension va pixel mode cua ca 6 file da doi chieu truoc khi dang ky. 6/6 khop.
v8ServiceDepth.rule: Moi ID dung dung mot service detail family; khong dung cheo giua cac slug. Render object-contain, alt="" + aria-hidden.

v9GenericDepth.rule: Nam generic service cu dung existing V6 signature dung route, bo sung depth data theo pageFamily; khong tao asset moi hay dung asset cheo.

v10EditorialDepth.verifiedOnIntegration: 5/5 PNG 1254x1254, RGBA, SHA-256 and byte count recorded after background cleanup.
v10EditorialDepth.rule: Supplemental illustration appears only in #hinh-thuc of its matching generic service; no cross-slug reuse.

v11PortfolioSignatureLayers.verifiedOnIntegration: 3/3 WebP co alpha, kich thuoc va SHA-256 duoc ghi lai sau khi toi uu.
v11PortfolioSignatureLayers.rule: Asset khong chua chu hay logo gia; duoc dung lam layer trang tri, khong che noi dung va khong thay the identity board goc.

v12PortfolioCaseRelics.renderedBy: ChatGPT (derived non-destructively from v11 case-object master)
v12PortfolioCaseRelics.verifiedOnIntegration: 3/3 WebP RGBA; native dimensions, bytes and SHA-256 recorded after lossless alpha crop and WebP optimization.
v12PortfolioCaseRelics.rule: Each relic is reserved for its matching case study only; no cross-case reuse and no text or logo embedded in the bitmap.

v13PortfolioEditorialLayers.verifiedOnIntegration: 4/4 WebP RGBA; alpha preserved and native dimensions, bytes and SHA-256 recorded after trim and optimization.
v13PortfolioEditorialLayers.rule: Each generated layer belongs to one narrative family; no embedded text, fake logo or cross-case reuse. Layers remain decorative and cannot cover content controls.

v14PortfolioSignatureLayers.verifiedOnIntegration: 4/4 WebP RGBA; generated alpha verified and native dimensions, bytes and SHA-256 recorded after WebP optimization.
v14PortfolioSignatureLayers.rule: Physical signature layers are tied to their narrative chapter, stay below readable content, and contain no embedded copy or brand mark.

v15PortfolioApplicationLayers.verifiedOnIntegration: 4/4 WebP RGBA with non-opaque alpha; native dimensions, bytes and SHA-256 recorded after WebP optimization.
v15PortfolioApplicationLayers.rule: Each application page receives its own material vocabulary; layers remain decorative, text-free and below readable content and primary mockups.

v16PortfolioPhysicalForegrounds.authority: User review requesting real component assets across the remaining sparse portfolio pages
v16PortfolioPhysicalForegrounds.verifiedOnIntegration: 5/5 optimized WebP files preserve a non-opaque alpha channel; dimensions, bytes and SHA-256 recorded after trim.
v16PortfolioPhysicalForegrounds.rule: Each physical foreground is reserved for its matching chapter, contains no readable text or logo, and stays below primary content.
